data.description:
# Documentation sweep for discard cost

## Goal

Update every player-facing and developer-facing description of hand discard so none still claims it is free. Covers parent AC5.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `docs/main-street/core-rules-and-mechanics.md` moves "Discarding from hand" out of the free-operations list and documents the reputation cost and clamp.
- `example-games/main-street/README.md` states the reputation cost.
- `MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` no longer advertises discard as free; `MainStreetHint.ts` mentions the cost.
- A grep for stale "free" discard references across source and docs returns none.
- Any relevant wiki/docs-site entry is updated or a follow-up work item is created.
- Parent AC traceability — **Documentation:** The rules docs, the Main Street README, and the in-game HUD tooltip that currently describe discard as free are updated to state the reputation cost; the engine/schema doc comments ("for free") are corrected. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.

## Minimal Implementation

- Edit the rules doc, README, tooltip string, and hint text.
- Grep to verify no stale references remain.

## Dependencies

- Depends on `CG-0MUEQ12ED0042425` (engine).

## Key Files

- `docs/main-street/core-rules-and-mechanics.md`
- `example-games/main-street/README.md`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetHint.ts`

data.comment: Producer approved the 9-repo list and the two assumptions (this session, no repo creation yet): (1) all Main-Street-specific tooling — src/ui/debug cheat tools, scripts/balance/**, monte-carlo, card generators, tutorial E2E — moves into tce-main-street; extract a shared balance layer later only if a second game needs it. (2) scripts/adapters/ framework (AdapterRegistry, ReplayAdapter, index) stays in core; the per-game adapters (Golf, BeleagueredCastle, Feudalism, LostCities, SushiGo, MainStreet) move to their games, and adapter registration becomes config-driven alongside scene registration.
